name: com.trtc.tuikit.common.foregroundservice.MediaForegroundService
description: Tencent TRTC UI Kit uses this media-playback foreground service and shows a notification with the supplied title and description during playback. This lets playback continue as a foreground task while the app is away.
disableEffect: Playback that relies on this service may stop when the app is in the background.
